summary: Make Side Scroller browser-input regression checks wait for the actual battle state and use the configured touch input path.

spec.reason: Movement, restart behavior, controls, and player-facing content are unchanged.

design.reason: This update only strengthens browser automation around existing keyboard and touch behavior.

validation: The ArrowRight check now enters a real battle, verifies the Phaser key state, observes player movement through the natural update loop, and verifies key release.
The phone restart check now sends a real touch-screen tap in its touch-enabled browser context instead of a synthetic mouse click.
The two affected checks passed 20 of 20 repetitions each in WebKit and 10 of 10 repetitions each in Chromium.
Side Scroller lint, typecheck, build, and all 141 unit tests passed.
limitations: Physical iOS and Android devices remain unverified.
